dialogues.jp: ──ああ、またか。

心の準備もそこそこに、意識はどんぶらこと流
されていく。
dialogues.en: "......Kazami Academy?"
dialogues.text: "......Kazami Academy?"

dialogues.jp: 誰かが見ている、その夢へと。
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, I'm surrounded by crowds, and I look
around.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden, I'm surrounded by crowds, and I look
around.

dialogues.en:
There are lots of students. They're walking into the school
building.
dialogues.text:
There are lots of students. They're walking into the school
building.

dialogues.en: "......It's morning?"
dialogues.text: "......It's morning?"

dialogues.en: I look up in the sky and see the sun shining very gently.
dialogues.text: I look up in the sky and see the sun shining very gently.

dialogues.jp: 「……風見学園？」
dialogues.en: "It is morning......"
dialogues.text: "It is morning......"

dialogues.en: "What's wrong, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, niisan?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突に｛ざっとう／雑踏｝に取り巻かれ、辺りを見回す。
dialogues.en: "Wow."
dialogues.text: "Wow."

dialogues.jp:
ワイワイガヤガヤ──学生達の姿。ぞろぞろ校
舎に向かっている。
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean 'wow'...... Don't rub your eyes like that,
or you will get germs in your eyes."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean 'wow'...... Don't rub your eyes like that,
or you will get germs in your eyes."

dialogues.en: She's talking like my mother. I put my hands down.
dialogues.text: She's talking like my mother. I put my hands down.

dialogues.jp:
見上げると、それほど熱を感じさせない太陽が
斜めに見下ろしている。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I wasn't expecting to see you here."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I wasn't expecting to see you here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、どうしたの？」
dialogues.en:
"What are you talking about......? Are you still
half-sleeping?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you talking about......? Are you still
half-sleeping?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うおっ」
dialogues.en:
"Let's hurry up. We're here already but we'll be late for
the first class."
dialogues.text:
"Let's hurry up. We're here already but we'll be late for
the first class."

dialogues.jp: 母親のように言われ、俺は手を下ろした。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's right."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's right."

dialogues.jp:
「あいや、何となくな。お前が居るとは思わな
　かった」
dialogues.en: I start to run.
dialogues.text: I start to run.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「変な事言って……寝ぼけてるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, did you hear about the transfer student coming today?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, did you hear about the transfer student coming today?"

dialogues.jp: 建設的な意見に、さっそく足を回転させる。
dialogues.en: "......A transfer student?"
dialogues.text: "......A transfer student?"

dialogues.jp: どっかで聞いた話だな。
dialogues.en: I think I heard about that before.
dialogues.text: I think I heard about that before.

dialogues.jp: あ、さくらんぼか。
dialogues.en: Oh, Sakura.
dialogues.text: Oh, Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「……さくらか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you talking about Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you talking about Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、寝ぼけてる？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, are you really awake?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, are you really awake?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうかもな。そもそも、まあ、夢の中だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not sure, because I'm in a dream right now, you know."
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure, because I'm in a dream right now, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「変な兄さん」
dialogues.en: "You are weird."
dialogues.text: "You are weird."

dialogues.jp:
あくまで常識的な我が妹は、前へと進むと、く
るりと笑顔で振り返った。
dialogues.en: She walks forward and turns around with a smile.
dialogues.text: She walks forward and turns around with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「お、と」
俺の教室はここかな？
dialogues.en: Is this my classroom?
dialogues.text: Is this my classroom?

dialogues.jp:
音夢はどこかに行ってしまい、俺はひとりで教
室のドアの前に立っている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu disappeared, and now I'm standing in front of a
classroom door alone.
dialogues.text:
Nemu disappeared, and now I'm standing in front of a
classroom door alone.

dialogues.jp: まあ、ここだろう。
dialogues.en: I think this is my classroom.
dialogues.text: I think this is my classroom.

dialogues.jp:
ドアに手を掛けようとして、ふとその動きが止
まる。教室の中は、死んだように静かだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm about to reach for the doorknob, but then I stop. Inside
the classroom is dead quiet.
dialogues.text:
I'm about to reach for the doorknob, but then I stop. Inside
the classroom is dead quiet.

dialogues.jp: （変だな……）
dialogues.en: (It's strange......)
dialogues.text: (It's strange......)

dialogues.jp: この静けさは何なんだろう？
dialogues.en: Why's it so quiet? I worry that I'm already late for class.
dialogues.text: Why's it so quiet? I worry that I'm already late for class.

dialogues.jp:
｛いぶか／訝｝しく思いながらも、遅刻の心配に背中を押さ
れる。

dialogues.en: "My name is Sagisawa. Nice to meet you......"
dialogues.text: "My name is Sagisawa. Nice to meet you......"

dialogues.jp: 教壇の横に立った少女は、ぺこりと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en:
The girl standing at the front of the classroom bows
slightly.
dialogues.text:
The girl standing at the front of the classroom bows
slightly.

dialogues.jp:
緊張しているのだろうか？　きちんと前に｛そろ／揃｝え
られた両手が、ぎゅっと組み合わされている。
dialogues.en:
She looks nervous. She holds her hands closed tightly in
front.
dialogues.text:
She looks nervous. She holds her hands closed tightly in
front.

dialogues.jp: だが、その横顔には穏やかな笑みがあった。
dialogues.en: But she's smiling gently.
dialogues.text: But she's smiling gently.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん……」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san......"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san......"

dialogues.jp:
教室の連中の顔がこちらに向くのを、視界の隅
で意識する。
dialogues.en:
Everybody in the classroom looks at me, and I see it with
the corner of my eyes.
dialogues.text:
Everybody in the classroom looks at me, and I see it with
the corner of my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
その少女──頼子さんが、まるで、スローモー
ションのように振り返った。
dialogues.en:
The girl -- Yoriko-san looks at me slowly as if she is in a
slow motion.
dialogues.text:
The girl -- Yoriko-san looks at me slowly as if she is in a
slow motion.

dialogues.jp: 笑顔。
dialogues.en: A smile.
dialogues.text: A smile.

dialogues.jp:
だがそれは、教室に向けられていたものとは、
たぶん違う。
dialogues.en:
It's a different smile from the one she gave to the class
earlier.
dialogues.text:
It's a different smile from the one she gave to the class
earlier.

dialogues.jp: もっと個人的で、ずっと親密。
dialogues.en: It's more personal... more intimate.
dialogues.text: It's more personal... more intimate.

dialogues.jp:
教室の目を気にしながら、反応に迷い、結局俺
は、会釈をするにとどめた。
dialogues.en:
I'm worried about the way everybody's looking at me, so I
don't know what to do other than just to bow back to her.
dialogues.text:
I'm worried about the way everybody's looking at me, so I
don't know what to do other than just to bow back to her.

dialogues.jp: （転校生……か）
dialogues.en: (She is a transfer student......?)
dialogues.text: (She is a transfer student......?)

dialogues.jp:
転校ってのは手続の事だと思う。移行の過程の、
手続き。
dialogues.en:
To become a transfer student, she needs to take a transfer
procedure.
dialogues.text:
To become a transfer student, she needs to take a transfer
procedure.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、夢ってやつは手続きを必要としないも
んだ。気が付けば、王様にも猫にもなっている。
dialogues.en:
But in a dream, I guess she doesn't need to. A king can be a
cat in a day in dreams.
dialogues.text:
But in a dream, I guess she doesn't need to. A king can be a
cat in a day in dreams.

dialogues.jp: （この夢は……）
dialogues.en: (But this dream......)
dialogues.text: (But this dream......)

dialogues.jp: この夢は、現実的な色彩を帯びている。
dialogues.en: This dream has a realistic element.
dialogues.text: This dream has a realistic element.

dialogues.jp:
それはたぶん、ほんとの現実とはかけ離れてい
るからだろう。
dialogues.en:
And that's probably because this dream's very different from
the reality.
dialogues.text:
And that's probably because this dream's very different from
the reality.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんが朝倉家でメイドをしている、本当の
現実とは……。
dialogues.en: The reality which Yoriko is the maid of my house.
dialogues.text: The reality which Yoriko is the maid of my house.

dialogues.jp: ◆夢の中を学園へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆It's happening again...◆
dialogues.text: ◆It's happening again...◆

dialogues.jp: 誰かの夢の中。
dialogues.en:
I'm not ready for this, but my consciousness starts to drift
away...
dialogues.text:
I'm not ready for this, but my consciousness starts to drift
away...

dialogues.jp: 現実と同じような風見学園、朝の風景。
dialogues.en: I start to drift away to someone's dream...
dialogues.text: I start to drift away to someone's dream...

dialogues.jp: そこに現れた転校生は、頼子さんだった。

これは夢で、たぶん、ほんとの現実とはかけ離
れている世界なのだ。
じゃあ本当の現実っていうのは……。
